what: Step-2 bail handoff only carries the reason, not the Step-2 context needed for recovery routing
scenario_or_breakage: If a Step-2 envelope-invalid or wrapper-validation bail reaches Step 18a before ship-pr-state has STALL_STEP/PHASE, classify can emit dispatch-failure from --bail-reason but resume_hint_for sees empty step/phase and returns none, so the recovery issue is filed but Step 2 is not retried
suggested_fix: Add the minimum Step-2 context handoff: set in-memory STALL_STEP=2 and PHASE=implementation on these Step-2 hard-bail paths or make classify infer step2-impl for the closed Step-2 bail tokens; add the planned argv-only regression with no persisted step/phase and assert RESUME_HINT=step2-impl
